This request adds files to a log.

Return data description

fileID | The ID of the file attached to the log.

params.name: assetID
params.description: The ID of the asset the log will be created for.

params.name: logs
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific logs. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of logIDs.

params.name: users
params.description: This parameter is used to only get logs created by specific users. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of userIDs.

params.name: logEntry
params.description: This is a parameter used to string search for manual log entry. This parameter expects a string with the wildcard %.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get logs that were last edited after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get logs that were last edited before the unix timestamp passed into the end parameter.

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter is used to paginate results based on the limit. Refer to Pagination section for more information.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what ID you want to start receiving results at.

items.docs:
This request returns logs created manually by users and automatically created (where userID=0) by certain actions taken on the asset. Logs related to tasks completed on an Asset will not be returned.

**Note:** this endpoint supports pagination. Please refer to the [**Pagination**](#pagination) section for more information.

Return data description

logID | The unique logID of the log.
dateCreated | The date the log was created as a UNIX timestamp.
assetD | The ID of the asset the log belongs to

This request returns the log entries for a part.

**Note:** this endpoint supports pagination. Please refer to the [Pagination](#pagination) section for more information.

Return data description

logID | The unique logID of the log.
dateCreated | The date the log was created as a UNIX timestamp.
partID | The partID the log belongs to.
sourceID | The sourceID of the source of the log. The sourceID can be as follows:, 1: Part name was changed., 2: Part Number was changed., 3: Parts were added/rem
